title: Elizondo says Monsanto-linked people are coming after him

tellings.quote: he says that some of the people coming after him are involved in Monsanto and there's this Monsanto Becktell connection from back in the day and they were maybe involved in the UFO alien issue as well.

plain: Some of the people working against Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks publicly about UFOs, are tied to Monsanto, the American chemical and farming company, according to what Elizondo told Jesse Michels. Michels passes this on in an episode with a guest named Brigham Buhler, and adds that there is an old link between Monsanto and Bechtel, a large engineering firm, and that these people may also have been involved in the UFO question. If true, it would tie big companies to whatever secrecy surrounds UFOs.
